confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Hampi food and drink prices. Hampi has no cost-of-living index, so restaurant and drink anchors rest on scattered, partly dated travel-blog and guide prices. Those sources gave a beer of about INR 180-220, a veg thali of about INR 100 and a mid-range platter of about INR 275. They gave no cappuccino price, so coffee is a general estimate. Cocktail and wine were not searched. Both are set relative to beer, and wine is rarely sold in Hampi, so the wine price is a rough guess. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, and I did not check any listings or booking pages. Hampi's accommodation is mostly unregistered guesthouses, and its 3-star supply is thin, so those anchors are uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on small backpacker-oriented Karnataka and South India tourist towns, such as Gokarna and Pushkar, with a small premium for Hampi's limited alcohol availability.
